title: Unit Event — Putting Feelings Into Words — Episode4 For the Band

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has begun performing in earnest at the live house. Honami comes up with a schedule to ensure that they can all work on their performance without overexerting themselves, but then she notices that Shiho seems different from usual...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I've finished cleaning up the counter. I'll be heading out after I've mopped down the floor.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Ah, good. Thank you.
Nice work.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I managed to get a hold of that bassist who's usually here and they even said that they'll see who'd be interested, so that should be a few more tickets...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(But who's left...?
Ideally, we can get people who'd enjoy seeing us perform...)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: By the way, Hinomori, how are ticket sales going? It's your first time, so it can't be easy.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
I've been selling them by myself because the others in my band are a little busy right now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes. It seemed like what's best for our band.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: But I'm sure you've come to realize that it's harder than it looks. Selling all thirty won't be easy.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we've decided to have a new song ready for our next show, so I want them to have time to practice playing it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which is how I arrived at selling these tickets on my own. I believe it's what is best for my band.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
If you say so, Hinomori.
I can't stop you...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: But I'd like for you to at least keep this in mind...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Bands that make one person carry most of the load usually don't last very long.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I understand that you have a lot on your plate right now, but if this keeps happening, nothing good is going to come out of it.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: It'll probably also start affecting your music.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I like Leo/need. I like your band's music. I want to keep supporting you and seeing your band grow.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I know that it's none of my business, but I sincerely believe that you should talk to your friends about this. One person shouldn't have to do all this on their own.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, your second song?! It's finished?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it took much longer than expected, but I think it's become something really special...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you.
But we still have a lot left to do.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, we're gonna have to play things by ear while we make any adjustments we think are going to be necessary.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wanna try playing through it once?
I can't wait much longer...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure. Let's get tuned up and do a quick sound check before we start.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is so amazing! I don't know what to do with myself!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You've had that smile on your face all day, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I understand how she feels. I had a lot of fun playing that song together with everyone too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But some things did give me a bit of trouble, so I'll need to keep an eye on those parts...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, me too!
I'll make sure to practice my parts so that I'm ready for next time...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, why don't we focus on that for next time and try going through it together afterward...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks, Miss Shiho! You're the best!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll be sure to keep practicing my parts too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, I should get going. Bye.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, I can play this section just fine...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Which leaves the leadup to the chorus...
The last time we played this, it really felt like my and Saki's sounds weren't meshing well.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Maybe I should tone down my drumming to let the synth shine through more since this is such a happy song.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I can play that part like this and...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I wonder what was on Shiho's mind today. I could've sworn that she was trying to tell us something...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think I'll ask her tomorrow when we discuss our schedule...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I couldn't find Shiho at her class or the cafeteria. It looks like she hasn't even read my messages. Where could she be having lunch?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yes... Okay...
I see. You have plans that day...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, it's not an issue.
I should be the one apologizing to you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But thank you. I hope things will work out next time...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What do I do? I still have so many to sell...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Sorry, I didn't mean to startle you.
Were you on the phone just now?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Anyway, what are you doing here?
Were you looking for me?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...!
I was hoping to check in with you about what we'll be doing for practice next week...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We'll be going through our new song on Sunday, so we're all gonna need to brush up on any parts that were giving us trouble until then.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
About that call you just made...
Is everything really okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are you sure? You can tell us about anything that's bothering you, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Break's almost over...
I'm gonna head back.
